No. The evidence shows no tree-cover loss events in 2024 or 2025 within this property. Hansen data runs through 2025, so those years were observed. The only corroborated post-baseline losses are in earlier years:

- 2021: 81.3 ha (2.23% of the asset)
- 2022: 0.6 ha
- 2023: 4.5 ha

Small patches under 0.5 ha are not counted as events. They total 37.3 ha in 2021, 0.3 ha in 2022 and 1.3 ha in 2023, and none are reported for 2024 or 2025. The tool lists no 2024 or 2025 entries at all, which I read as no detected loss, though it doesn't state that explicitly.

The data detects stand-replacing loss at 30 m resolution. It doesn't show whether the loss was deforestation, harvest, fire or something else, or whether it was authorized. The 2021 and 2023 losses fall in planted-forest context, so they may be plantation cutting, but the data can't confirm that.
